summary: Add a nullable boolean column marketing_opt_in with DEFAULT False on account_user, backfill existing rows to False using a condition that becomes false after update, then make the column NOT NULL after the old version retires. The column default ensures old version inserts False, preventing NULLs.
write_consistency: The column is created with DEFAULT False, so the old version's INSERT statements omit the column and receive False. The backfill stage sets any remaining rows where marketing_opt_in IS DISTINCT FROM False to False. After retire_old, the contract stage enforces NOT NULL, guaranteeing no NULL rows remain.

stages.description: Add nullable marketing_opt_in column with DEFAULT False.
sql: ALTER TABLE account_user ADD COLUMN marketing_opt_in BOOLEAN DEFAULT False;

stages.description: Backfill all rows where marketing_opt_in is not yet False to False.
sql: UPDATE account_user SET marketing_opt_in = False WHERE marketing_opt_in IS DISTINCT FROM False;
ALTER TABLE account_user ALTER COLUMN marketing_opt_in SET NOT NULL;
